def: a crash (of thunder), noise (of war), shout (of joy)

occurrences.text: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
Now why dost thou cry out aloud? is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
